profile.name: xArm协作机械臂
profile.description: 用于实验室自动化的协作机械臂，可执行关节与笛卡尔运动、轨迹录制与回放，并控制夹爪、工具端/控制器IO、Modbus外设以及力/力矩传感与力控功能。
profile.description_en: A collaborative robot for laboratory automation that supports joint and Cartesian motion, trajectory recording and playback, and control of grippers, tool/controller I/O, Modbus peripherals, and force-torque sensing and force-control functions.

registry.name: UFACTORY Uxbus Cmd
